title: Tidy HUD
description: A currently small and minimal collection of HUD features, primarily for PvP and SMPs.
body:
# Tidy HUD
![Full HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da51b9b2c64ef2398240bfde8d4dcc8947c8d18b.jpeg)
**---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**
![HUD Positions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84b6acd751fddd66314417667a0be4061681c075_0.webp)

## Description
Tidy HUD is a very minimal and simplistic HUD mod, primarily made for any sort of PvP and SMP server, I made this mod as something I wanted and decided to publish it for everyone to use. Consisting of only three basic features right now, an armor display, potion timers, a basic info HUD (XYZ, ping, tps and fps), tool, weapon and armor durability in tooltips, and the ability to enable/disable all of these features (default key is R-Shift) as well as reposition all these elements. The info HUD is disabled by default. If this mod gets enough traction I'd love to make a Discord to manage any bugs, suggestions and general conversations.

### Requirements
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

[Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

### Planned Additions
- Chat improvements
- Server/world specific kills/death tracker
- Maybe a light weight minimap
